title: koru project configuration
description: koru.json: app identity, web files, Android SDK range, permissions, plugins and signing.

appId.description: Android package name in reverse-domain form, for example com.example.myapp. Never change it after publishing.

name.description: Name shown under the launcher icon.

version.description: Version shown to people, for example 1.2.0.

versionCode.description: Whole number Android uses to order updates. Increase it for every release.

webDir.description: Folder with index.html and the static files to package, for example www or dist.

minSdk.description: Oldest supported Android API level (26 = Android 8.0).

targetSdk.description: Android API level the app targets. Must be at least minSdk.

permissions.description: Extra Android permissions, for example android.permission.INTERNET for HTTPS APIs.

anyOf.description: Custom plugin id declared in pluginManifests.

plugins.description: Enabled JavaScript APIs. Built-in: app, device, notifications, share, storage, vibration.

signingKey.description: Path to the PEM signing identity. Back it up: updates need the same key.

icon.description: Path to a PNG launcher icon.

spa.description: Serve index.html for unknown paths, for client-side routers.

nativeLibraries.description: Prebuilt JNI libraries per ABI, for example {"arm64-v8a": ["libs/libfoo.so"]}.
